articles.headline: Ivory Coast part ways with AFCON-winning coach Emerse Faé
articles.description: The Ivorian Football Federation have confirmed that Emerse Faé will leave his position as head coach upon the expiry of his contract on July 31, bringing to an end his remarkable two-and-a-half-year spell.

articles.headline: U.K. Prime Minister Andy Burnham becomes first leader of a major country to call on FIFA president Gianni Infantino to resign
articles.description: The U.K. Prime Minister Andy Burnham has called on FIFA President Gianni Infantino to resign over the plan to sell stakes in the World Cup to a private equity group.

articles.headline: FIFA advances plans for 64-team World Cup review despite private investment backlash
articles.description: FIFA has started a consultation process over an expansion of the men's World Cup to 64 teams, with documents seen by ESPN aiming for a decision by Aug. 14.

articles.headline: SAFA confirm Bafana boss Hugo Broos exit as South Africa men's head coach
articles.description: South African Football Association (SAFA) president Danny Jordaan confirmed the departure of Bafana Bafana head coach Hugo Broos on Friday, the final day of his contract, after five years.
